description: Observed-order sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_norm_D2_extrapolate_bc driven by problems/levelset_weno5_eno1_2d_bump_mms.esm, binding NX=NY together at N = 16, 32, 64, 128 (the operator is evaluated on a frozen field and accumulated linearly in w, so the sweep needs only a few right-hand-side evaluations per resolution). Accumulator form: u frozen at the smooth manufactured g = r^2 - 0.09 + 0.05 (max(0, 1 - r^2/0.28^2))^8 (increasing toward every wall so the guarded extrapolation ghost is linear; weno_band_cells = 1e9 so the WENO5 branch covers the whole interior block), w(0) = g, w_t = S (|grad g| - |grad u|_h), gated on w. The interior WENO5 error is high order; the three-cell ENO1 wall band is first order on the curved field, and its share of the L2 norm scales as sqrt(12/N) x h, so the expected L2 order is 1.5 (derived in the problem description; the Linf error is the wall band's first-order one and is not gated).
